stories.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define immutable audit log schema including event_type, actor, timestamp, payload, hash, previous_hash, and correlation_id. Align with existing debug_logger fields (chat metadata, token usage, error flags) and enforce write-once document structure in MongoDB.

stories.title: Append-Only Write Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement core audit logging pipeline enforcing strict append-only writes with no update/delete operations. Add hash chaining (previous_hash → hash) and deterministic hashing of payload to enable tamper detection. Ensure compatibility with existing debug_logger write patterns.

stories.title: Audit Log Read API (Controlled Access)
stories.description: Expose read-only API for audit logs with filtering by event_type, time range, actor, and correlation_id. Include optional hash chain verification on read. Ensure no mutation endpoints exist and restrict access to internal/admin contexts only.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing audit read API; must be built on top of debug_logger persistence

stories.title: System-Wide Audit Logging Integration
stories.description: Integrate append-only audit logging across tool_router, safety_service, and key domain services. Capture tool invocations, safety triggers, consent flows, and error events. Ensure sensitive data follows existing de-identification patterns before logging.

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Tamper Detection Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating append-only guarantees, hash chain integrity, deterministic hashing, and prevention of updates/deletes. Include tamper simulation (record mutation, chain break) and verify detection via read API.
